description: This is a Java source file defining the StartupException class, a custom exception used in the OFBiz framework to indicate issues during startup procedures.

classes.name: StartupException
classes.description: A final class extending Exception, used for signaling startup-related errors in OFBiz. It provides multiple constructors and overrides getMessage() to include nested exception messages.

methods.name: StartupException()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an exception with no detail message.

methods.name: StartupException(String msg)
methods.description: Constructor with a specified detail message.

methods.name: StartupException(String msg, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor with a detail message and a nested cause.

methods.name: StartupException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor with a nested cause only.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Returns the message including the cause's message if present.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage()
methods.description: Returns the message without including the cause's message.
